coordinate_system: formal cross-backbone PEEH TRAIN-only canonical basis, unchanged
candidate_blocks: formal eigengap partition, rank at most 4

selectors.PU: exact formal Protected union: persistence_supported AND absolute_CI_low>0 AND excess_CI_low>0
selectors.U_only: exact-rank subset maximizing sum min(absolute_CI_low, excess_CI_low), ignoring persistence gate
selectors.P_only: exact-rank subset maximizing sum (rho-null_p95), ignoring predictive utility

empty_PU: k=0; primary non-estimable; do not force a nonzero selector
optimization: deterministic exact 0/1 rank-knapsack over candidate blocks
ties: lexicographically smallest ascending block-index tuple for mathematically identical summed scores
random_controls: 100 exact-rank-k coordinate subsets shared unchanged across PU/U_only/P_only within a cell, formal final-random stable_seed scheme
primary_endpoint: subject-level minimum BA across heldout sessions per checkpoint, then fold/seed mean within biological subject; paired PU minus U_only
bootstrap: 20000 deterministic paired draws over biological subjects
